# An Foclóir Beag _(Ó Dónaill & Ua Maoileoin, 1991)_

This is a searchable electronic version of the _Foclóir Beag_ monolingual Irish dictionary, which was first published in 1991. The original text of the dictionary is faithfully adhered to, except for a few minor changes to the notation for clarity (e.g. the grammatical label _fir1_ rather than _f1_).

## How to use

To look up a word, simply type the word in the search box and click to find the relevant information in _Foclóir Beag_. The entry or entries for that word in _Foclóir Beag_ are given first, followed by any related entries, followed by sample phrases in which the search word occurs under other entries within _Foclóir Beag_.

On the right of the screen is displayed an index of the neighbouring _Foclóir Beag_ headwords, while a selection of words similar to the search word is displayed directly below the search box.
